question: The central theme of Tokyo Paralympic 2020 was ________.
solution:
Correct answer is __**United by Emotion.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The organisers of Tokyo 2020 recently released the theme of this year's Olympics and Paralympics as **'United by Emotion'.**
 
• The theme reflects the unifying power of sports, as per the organisers.
 
• **Sanjeev Singh** composed the theme song of India for Tokyo Paralympics 2020.
 
• The new Olympic motto now reads: **“Faster, Higher, Stronger – Together”**
 
• The Tokyo 2020 Organising Committee has announced the Paralympic competition schedule, following the Games' postponement to 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1db715f5735d6103b392e4b97b796151f88b881e0c9b9a514ed55c463b8f5482.png] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The objective of the 2012 Olympic and Paralympic Games was to “**inspire a generation**”.​​ 
 
• In 2022, the theme for Olympic Day is** Together, For a Peaceful World.**
 
• The Slogan “**One World, One Dream**” is said to fully send back the essence and the universal values of the Olympic spirit – unity, friendship, progress, harmony, participation, and dream. The aim also manifests the core concepts of the Beijing Olympic Games – Green Olympics, High-tech Olympics, and People's Olympics.
